purpose: The published codes that turn polarised spectra into a magnetic map: line depths in a model atmosphere (Korg), least-squares deconvolution (LSDpy), the longitudinal field (SpecpolFlow) and Zeeman-Doppler imaging (ZDIpy). They are run as tools; none of their code is in this repository.

licenses.Korg: BSD-3-Clause (A. J. Wheeler et al.); cite Wheeler et al. 2023, AJ 165, 68 and 2024, AJ 167, 83; its model atmospheres are the MARCS grid made for SDSS
licenses.ZDIpy: GPL-2.0 (C. P. Folsom); cite Folsom et al. 2018, MNRAS 474, 4956

notes: scipy stays below 1.17: ZDIpy calls scipy.special.lpmn, which 1.17 removes.
SpecpolFlow imports tkinter for its mask-cleaning window; tools.py stands a placeholder in for it, because the window is never opened here.
Korg's version is the one korg/Manifest.toml resolves (1.3.1); its packages and atmosphere grids go in the toolchain's own depot, not the user's.
